method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reconstruction of the model-of-a-set definition, evaluation of the nonexpressibility example, replay of the three order-property biconditionals, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Sentence-definable properties of structures, models of sentence sets, and the first-order axiomatization of partial orders.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: We may choose the intended structures and interpretations, but the model-theoretic question is which conditions or classes of structures can be captured by a sentence or sentence set. No sentence forces the arithmetic domain to be exactly the natural numbers, although some structural properties are expressible.
samples.checks: The freedom to choose intended interpretations, ordering and membership examples, sentence-versus-sentence-set alternatives, one-way restriction on the natural-number example and final class characterization are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A structure M is a model of a sentence set Gamma exactly when M satisfies every sentence A belonging to Gamma.
samples.checks: Language membership, universal range over Gamma, satisfaction notation and model terminology are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The three displayed sentences say that the interpretation of less-than-or-equal is reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive. Their common models are therefore precisely partial orders, so the sentences may serve as axioms for the first-order theory of partial orders.
samples.checks: All three biconditionals, their variable patterns, the displayed axiom set, exact property conjunction and final axiomatic-theory claim are retained.

source_observations: No deterministic frozen-source defect requiring a Marathi correction was found in this unit.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match the frozen source exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact Marathi label for model-theoretic expressibility and structural property remains explicitly open to specialist review in T229.
No TeX reader build was run for this individual unit.
